correctness.rationale: For p+q=n, the two exact Laplacian support populations are q*g_A-S_B and p*g_B-S_A. Gaussian block maxima/minima at b_n=Phi^-1(1-2/n), together with τ_n=2(q-p)b_n²/n, converge to four independent Gumbels after normalization. The S_A,S_B noise is o_P(n/b_n), radial normalization contributes o_P(1), and the exponential-race maximum has shift log(2cosh(τ/2)) and an independent Bernoulli logistic(τ) label. Twice applying this proves the joint width and two-label limit; transitivity yields normal cone mass, and direct row-difference norms yield pairwise distances. An independent 243-case finite identity/distances program agreed to floating error below 8e-15; this is only finite corroboration.
